title: Skin Care for Nurses: Hands, Masks and a 3-Minute Routine After Long Shifts
ex: Handwashing, sanitiser, gloves, masks, AC wards and rotating shifts: a simple, realistic skin care routine for nurses in Indian hospitals.
rt: Skin Care for Nurses: Hands, Masks, Shift Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for nurses: protect hands from constant washing and gloves, keep your face comfortable under masks and AC, and a 3-minute routine after any shift.
quick: Nurses need hand care first: dry hands fully, use lukewarm water, moisturise when the ward allows and apply a thick cream after duty. Add a thin moisturiser under masks, sunscreen for the commute and a short cleanse-and-cream routine before sleep at any hour.
facts: Follow your hospital's hand-hygiene and infection-control rules first
Thick cream on hands after duty helps dry, cracked skin
A thin moisturiser before the mask reduces friction
Persistent hand rashes need staff health or a dermatologist
